newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ace Koeki shares pulled down by interim losses.
newsitem.headline: Ace Koeki shares pulled down by interim losses.

text.p: Shares of commodity futures trader Ace Koeki Co Ltd slipped in Wednesday morning over-the-counter (OTC) trade, hurt by the firm's interim losses announced on Tuesday, traders said.
The share price was down 70 yen at 1,010 yen at 0128 GMT. Volume was 27,000 shares.
The firm was the second largest percentage loser on the OTC market.
Ace Koeki said on Tuesday that it had posted a parent current loss of 1.64 billion for the six months to September 30.
In the same period a year ago, it posted a parent current profit of 1.0 billion yen.
